archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Once Human Season 5 Launches November 18

entries.headline: Mario Kart World Open Qualifier Runs November 21–22
entries.summary: Nintendo says the November 2026 open event will run from 2:00 p.m. PT on November 21 to 6:00 p.m. PT on November 22 for eligible players in the stated Americas regions, serving as a qualifier for December's North American Fall Cup.
entries.verification: Nintendo's official US event page was opened and supports the dates, Pacific-time schedule, regional eligibility, Nintendo Switch 2 requirement and qualifier status.
entries.timeNote: Event times are retained in Pacific Time because the page snapshot does not provide a reliable publication timestamp.
entries.regionLabel: Specified United States, Canada and Mexico eligibility

entries.headline: Fable Shows New Quest Gameplay for Xbox's 25th Anniversary
entries.summary: Xbox Wire published new quest gameplay for Fable during the 25th-anniversary event. The packet snapshot retains only the page title, so no additional combat or story details are asserted.
entries.verification: The official Xbox Wire page was opened and confirms a new quest-gameplay presentation; the copy stays within the title-level evidence preserved in the packet.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire timestamp converts to 3:00 a.m. Beijing Time on November 13, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Once Human Season 5 Launches November 18 with Music-Driven Colossus Battles
entries.summary: Season 5: Dissonant Resonance launches globally on PS5 on November 18. Four Emotion Zones reshape combat as players shoot notes, purify scores and trigger rewards while the Sky Colossus reacts to battle rhythms and opens the route to its boss encounter.
entries.verification: The PlayStation Blog developer article was opened and supports the season name, global November 18 launch, PS5 platform and the stated music, Emotion Zone and Sky Colossus mechanics.
entries.timeNote: The PlayStation Blog timestamp converts to 7:00 a.m. Beijing Time on November 13, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations Adds Slaughter Mode on November 16
entries.summary: Xbox Wire confirms that Slaughter Mode arrives for DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations on November 16. The packet snapshot does not preserve the full mode description, so no additional mechanics are asserted.
entries.verification: The official Xbox Wire page was opened; its title supports the mode name, associated content and November 16 date.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire timestamp converts to 4:00 a.m. Beijing Time on November 13, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Moves Up to February 4, 2027
entries.summary: Two independent outlets report that Square Enix moved the release from February 16 to February 4, 2027, with the Steam version due February 5. Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch digital pre-orders must be placed again, with reservations expected to reopen around November 26.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer independently support the revised February 4 date, the February 5 Steam date and the former February 16 schedule; the latter also reports the Switch pre-order reset and expected reopening window.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's timestamp converts to 3:36 p.m. Beijing Time on November 12, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Million Depth Launches a Nintendo Switch Demo with Save Transfer
entries.summary: PLAYISM released a Nintendo Switch demo for Million Depth on November 12. It lets players complete the alpha route, one of the full game's three routes, and transfer the save into the Nintendo Switch release arriving December 3. The PC version is already available on Steam.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and 4Gamer independently confirm the Switch demo and save transfer. 4Gamer identifies the complete alpha route, while AUTOMATON supports the December 3 Switch release and existing PC edition.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's timestamp converts to 2:17 p.m. Beijing Time on November 12, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Football Manager 27 Touch Arrives on Apple Arcade
entries.summary: Sega released Football Manager 27 Touch on Apple Arcade on November 11 for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision and Apple TV. The edition includes the same 161 leagues as the PC and console versions.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the Apple Arcade release, listed devices and 161-league count. Other December additions mentioned in the same article are not folded into this entry.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's timestamp converts to 4:32 p.m. Beijing Time on November 12, within the fixed window; the November 11 launch date follows the report.
